name: ready-to-quote-guard
label: Ready-to-quote guard
description: Enforces the one hard rule of the underwriting review (a packet with a missing required document can never be ready-to-quote) at the platform layer, for EVERY writer. The analyze handler already downgrades ready-to-quote in code, but the chat agent has rw store tools and a future tool could regress. This preToolUse hook fires on any store__submissions__set / store__risk_findings__set, reads the documents store for that submission, and blocks the write when a required doc isn't received. Capability gate (store:read) + verified caller are platform-supplied, while the policy (the rule) is the author's, owned here.
